title: The Rangers tied the game with two runs in the seventh inning. Travis Demeritte
snippet: The Rangers tied the game with two runs in the seventh inning. Travis Demeritte dropped a fly ball to start the inning and his strong throw on a sacrifice fly was just late for the tie.
